title: Assembling a Release Branch
description: Elena needs a release branch containing the checkout and notifications features, while keeping the experimental search feature out of the release.
objective: Create a release branch from main, include checkout and notifications, and keep experimental search out of the release.

whatToDo.text: Create a new release branch based on main.
Include the checkout feature in the release branch.
Include the notifications feature in the release branch.
Keep the experimental search feature out of the release.

hints: Start from main and create a new branch for the release.
Merge the checkout and notifications feature branches into your release branch.

intro.message: For this release, I need checkout and notifications, but the experimental search feature is not ready yet. Let's assemble the release branch carefully.

createRelease.message: Good. You created a separate release branch from main.

includeCheckout.message: Nice. The checkout feature is now included.

excludeSearch.message: Perfect. The release is complete and the experimental search feature stays out.

success.message: Perfect. The release contains exactly the features we need.

failure.message: The release branch is not assembled correctly yet.
